mapper.sql: SELECT g.*,o.username AS owner_name,m.username AS member_name, g.member_id=#{userId} AS incoming,g.expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS expired FROM family_grants g JOIN users o ON o.id=g.owner_id JOIN users m ON m.id=g.member_id
mapper.select: WHERE g.owner_id=#{userId} OR g.member_id=#{userId} ORDER BY g.id DESC
WHERE g.id=#{id} AND g.member_id=#{userId} AND g.accepted=TRUE AND g.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() AND o.enabled=TRUE AND m.enabled=TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM family_grants WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND member_id=#{memberId}
DELETE FROM family_grants WHERE id=#{id} AND (owner_id=#{userId} OR member_id=#{userId})
